text:
Turned back upon itself, the human gaze

is, alas, only a sad bewilderment.

We know nothing, we shall never know,

in present pain or in the blind future

there is only something that is certain, certain, certain:

dreams have lost the battle.


That the smallest longings, as much

as the principal hopes,

have systematically been ruined.

On the horizon that remains equally for us are missing

the small rose and the great sun.

translation.title: Turned Back upon Itself
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the repeated certainty and the final absent rose and sun.
